title: Remaining test-integration-svc failures across 31 files (audit chain, webhook, entity, env, adp clusters)
symptom: After the ISS-0150 fixes, zig build test-integration-svc still exits 1 with 86 failing blocks on a freshly migrated database. 24 belong to ISS-0182 and ISS-0183; the remaining 62 are spread across 31 files: svc04_admin_api_test (6), xc06_backwards_compatibility_test (5), xc02_audit_immutability_test (5), obs03_audit_log_test (5), ext02_webhook_dispatch_test (5), exp401_exp402_comp_restore_test (5), exp601_tier_quota_test (4), adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain_test (4), and 23 files with 1 to 3 each.
root_cause_analysis: DIAGNOSED (2026-08-08, WF03-GH517-20260808 Step 01, ISSUE-FIXER). Re-measured against a freshly migrated database: 635 pass, 9 skip, 88 fail, 1 crashed, 733 total, 52 leaks -- the original 62/31-file count was stale (surface shifted after 10 adjacent GH issues resolved on 2026-08-07). The original 85x C22021 hypothesis was a misdiagnosis: those errors are the expected, caught-and-handled internal footprint of audit_chain_utf8_test.zig deliberately proving migration 1107's EXCEPTION guard works; that file's tests all pass. 93 real failures clustered into 11 groups (see docs/issue-reports/ISS-0184-diagnosis.yaml for full detail): C1 (resource_id TEXT/::uuid cast mismatch, largest cluster) turned out to be a follow-on of already-OPEN ISS-0094/GH#348, updated rather than refiled. C2 (webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref never reaching freshly-provisioned tenant schemas) turned out to be an incomplete fix of already-CLOSED ISS-0112/GH#375, reopened with reproduction. C10 (env01_test stale-row pollution) turned out to be fully explained by already-OPEN-but-unqueued ISS-0100/GH#357, added to the queue. C4 (5 ADP0x migration-column-check failures) and C5 (repository_test content_hash) are already covered by OPEN/QUEUED ISS-0185 and ISS-0183 respectively -- no action needed. C3 (event_store store.zig leak) is a small, well-understood, single-file direct-fix candidate, same shape as the already-resolved GH#526. C6/C7/C8/C9 (svc04 validation, exp601 quota-profile resolution, sch02 scheduler logic, idn02/idn03 authorization) are genuinely new and distinct, filed as ISS-0616 through ISS-0619. C11 (2 OS-level socket errors under full-suite contention) noted but not filed -- likely non-deterministic infra flakiness of an already-addressed class.
impact: test-integration-svc cannot reach exit 0 while these remain, which keeps the Green-Main Gate red for every future WF-02 and WF-03 run.
acceptance_criteria: Each listed cluster is diagnosed to a named root cause and either fixed or split into its own issue
zig build test-integration-svc exits 0 against a freshly migrated database
The run is measured before and after on two pristine databases so pre-existing failures are not mistaken for regressions

notes: Filed per CLAUDE.md 'No Issue Left Local-Only' and the 'filed and forwarded, not fixed here' scope boundary. ISS-0150 fixed 3 root causes (33 blocks) with zero regressions; this cluster has a distinct root cause and belongs in its own run. Diagnosis-and-triage pass (2026-08-08) split the residue into 11 sub-clusters: 3 reused/reopened existing issues, 2 already covered by other queued issues, 4 filed as new issues, 1 direct-fix candidate, 1 noted-not-filed (flaky infra). This holding issue itself has no more independent work beyond what its sub-issues now track -- recommend closing once C3's direct fix lands, since every other cluster is now tracked elsewhere.
